summary: Woori Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution to cancel 4,854,368 common shares, valued at approximately KRW 150 billion based on the previous day's closing price of KRW 30,900. The cancellation represents about 0.67% of shares outstanding and will be funded from distributable profits, with no reduction in paid-in capital. Shares will be acquired via a trust agreement over a six-month period ending January 22, 2027, then canceled. This is a capital return event aimed at enhancing shareholder value through a treasury share cancellation—a common capital returns mechanism. Watch for the actual acquisition price and timing of completion.
